assets.name: skill_chain_ring
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: isolated transparent PNG sprite for a Unity medieval casual fantasy UI.
Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the thin antique-gold chain behind the three equipped skill medallions in the center of the reference. Generate ONLY that chain, as a complete perfectly circular ring, with no medallions.
A single delicate continuous loop of small interlocked oval gold chain links seen directly front-on. Circle diameter 80% of the square canvas. Very thin chain line: roughly 12 pixels thickness on a 1024x1024 canvas, around 1.5% of circle diameter. Smooth high resolution illustrated 2D metal, subdued antique champagne gold with restrained small bevel highlights and dark thin edging. The ring must be a mathematically round circle, not oval, all links similar size.
Genuinely transparent background. BOTH the inside of the ring and all outside space must be completely transparent alpha0. Every hole between chain links must be transparent too. Only the chain itself has visible pixels. No opaque disk, no central background, no shadow, no glow, no cloth, no jewels, no spikes, no medallions, no symbols, no text, no frame. Exactly one chain loop, not two concentric loops. No pixel art or 3D render. Fully visible centered silhouette.
assets.revisionPrompt: Edit only chain thickness in this ring UI asset. Keep the exact same centered circular path, same diameter, same full transparent exterior and transparent center. Reduce ALL chain links to ONE THIRD their current thickness and size; replace each large link with approximately three much smaller delicate links following the same circle path, so the overall continuous chain stroke is only12pixels thick on a1024pixel square. The current heavy jewelry chain is much too thick. This must read as a very slender decorative chain line behind skill icons, not a necklace. Subdued antique gold simple2D smalllinks, no bulky3D shine. Keep perfect circle geometry, no medallions, no text, no other objects, completely transparent all non-chain areas.
